scenario: [LUNI.6.2]: each of `units.audio`'s standalone dB units is the single member of its own scalar group, so `3_dB + 3_dBFS` adds two groups and is refused with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. It shows `dB` and `dBFS` do not share a group. PATH PINNED: the shipped library, read in place (`stdlib`, [RCTS.1.2.14]), then the compiler's dimension check on the addition.
rules_ds:
from units.audio import dB, dBFS

schema Level scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: dB mutable

rule r:
    Level l where l.v > 3_dB + 3_dBFS
->
    log info "x"
